recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a lookup sheet to the existing Excel workbook: one part-code input cell, plus exact-match formulas that return Shelf and Selling price from the authoritative list, keep codes as text, and show 'Code not found' for unknown codes.

labels.Requirements and who asked: **Requirements and who asked:** You need to enter a part code and immediately see its shelf location and selling price.
labels.Deleted: **Deleted:** A separate app, database, hosting and synchronization.
labels.Bottleneck: **Bottleneck:** Scrolling through the existing list about 40 times a day.
labels.Checked myself: **Checked myself:** You told me Excel is installed, the workbook contains 240 unique codes, and all lookups happen on one laptop.

note: The Deleted line names generic machinery (app, database, hosting, sync) but not Retool/Supabase or the Next.js portal; the reply rejects both by name only later in the body.
